question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north. Only two people sit to the left of K. Only three people sit between K and L. Only one person sits between L and J. P sits to the immediate left of I. Q is not an immediate neighbour of L. How many people sit to the right of R?
solution:
Given : Seven people, I, J, K, L, P, Q and R, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only two people sit to the left of K.
 
• Only three people sit between K and L.
 
• Only one person sits between L and J.
 
• P sits to the immediate left of I.
 
• Q is not an immediate neighbour of L
 
• The final Arrangement is [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50798e203769bb4cf49c03a7731e85fd94961235ac2c75ed0335e27b92da1829.png] 
 
• Only one person L, sits to the right of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
